$comment: Companion to Data/Config.xlsx. Holds the ONE thing that does not belong in a config spreadsheet: nuget packages and libraries. Folders, per-tenant assets, queues, and buckets all live in Data/Config.xlsx.

packages.$comment: Glob path (relative to repo root) to your published process .nupkg. UiPath Studio Publish writes it; the version is read from the filename. autoVersion bumps to -cicd.N if that version already exists in Orchestrator.

libraries.$comment: Shared library .nupkg files. Libraries are tenant-scoped (available to every folder). Leave the array empty if this project has no libraries to publish.
